We have a user asking us to fix runtime errors after previous attempts. The error says "failed to load page: goto: net::ERR_FILE_NOT_FOUND at file:///tmp/slop-factory-work/temporal-bubble-2-f678bd66/index.html".

So the file "index.html" does not exist at that absolute path. The previous attempts likely didn't properly create index.html. The instructions in this session said "You must produce two output files in this turn: `index.html` and `meta.json`". The user gave us a final request to do TASK 1: generate index.html and meta.json. The assistant earlier responded with a load of the repository's file listing but didn't actually write index.html, meta.json. The user now says page fails to load (file not found). So we need to create index.html and meta.json files.

Goal: Create a minimal HTML scaffold with required header etc, but we should also ensure that the page loads without errors. Currently file not found. So we must write index.html and meta.json in the working directory. According to instructions, we should "write" files using the "write" tool to create them. In this process we need to adhere to CONVENTIONS.md: The page must include required structure and script block (empty script block permissible). No runtime errors. We can output minimal code that includes script tag with just an empty block or perhaps some placeholder code that does nothing but sets up required global __game object? The validator checks for console errors in first 5 seconds and also that canvas displays something after 3 secs (non-blank pixels). So just having an empty script will likely cause canvas to be blank and not pass "canvas has non-blank pixels after 3 seconds". However the tasks are in phases; task 1 is just scaffold and meta.json, and "game does not need to be playable yet" but it must load without console errors. Does the validation still check for canvas non-blank? According to CONVENTIONS.md, the required checks are listed under "What the validator checks". The full validator will run after each task? The instruction says "After each task you complete, the page is loaded in a real headless browser and console errors are checked." It says "If any are found, you'll be asked to fix them". It doesn't mention checking for non-blank canvas or the other contract? Probably the validator checks everything, including canvas non-blank after 3 seconds. But the user statement says "The game does not need to be playable yet. It just needs to load in a browser without console errors." So maybe the validator will not enforce non-blank canvas at this early stage. Hard to guess. But they said "The page is loaded in a real headless browser and console errors are checked." So maybe only console errors matter currently. So we can produce a minimal index.html page that contains the scaffold and an empty script with maybe a comment to avoid errors.

We need to create meta.json matching title etc.

The title: "Temporal Bubble". Description: "Tap creates a short‑lived bubble around the dot that freezes all obstacles inside it for half a second, letting you slip through tight clusters; the bubble has a cooldown to prevent spamming." The controls: Should reflect typical controls: maybe "Tap to create bubble", "Press R or click Restart". The tags: presumably something like ["arcade", "puzzle", "temporal", "bubble"]? The guidelines say tags are optional and lowercased. We'll just use ["arcade", "temporal", "bubble"].

But we must ensure meta.json fields meet constraints: description length between 20-400 characters. That should be okay. Controls non-empty array. Tag lowercase.

The index.html: Must have empty script block (I guess we can leave script comment). But to avoid errors we can have script block where we define a minimal __game object at start? Actually the Observable contract is likely not enforced yet or maybe will be later; but it could cause test failures later. Since tasks progress later, we should add that later. For now we can just have empty script to at least avoid errors.

But script must not produce any errors. So we will write something like:

<script>
  // placeholder for game logic
</script>

Also header must match meta.json. We'll embed the title and description.

Ensure html meets required structure exactly as in CONVENTIONS.md:

- DOCTYPE, html lang="en"
- head with meta charset utf-8, title, style block
- style: maybe just placeholders. At minimum allow empty <style></style>.

But style can't be empty? It can be empty.

We'll include CSS styling similar to reference (like dark background). Not needed but okay.

Place canvas id="game" width="800" height="600".

Button after canvas with id="restart", class="game-restart". Must be visible. We'll include text "Restart".

The script block is at end of body.

We must write with "write" tool.

We also need to add meta.json.

Before writing, we might want to see if there are any files already. Let's check file existence.
